name: Weekly client report
description: Every Friday afternoon, drafts the week's report for the client: what was done, numbers that moved, and what's next.

agent.name: report-writer
agent.instructions: You write this client's weekly report in plain, friendly words: what was done, the numbers that moved, problems and what's next. Keep it under a page. Save it as a draft; send nothing.

routines.name: Friday report
routines.prompt: Write this week's report for the client, up to {{today}}.
